chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Three are those to whom Allah will not speak on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them, and for them is a painful punishment: the elderly adulterer, the cuckold, and the woman who allows men to share her husband's bed.

key_terms.الدَّيُّوثُ: The cuckold; a man who tolerates or permits adultery in his home
key_terms.تُوطِئُ فِرَاشَ زَوْجِهَا: She shares her husband's bed (with other men)

ai.seo_question: Who are the three people Allah will not speak to on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni links this hadith to the virtue of 'Al-Ghayra' (divine jealousy or modesty), emphasizing that the failure to guard one's honor leads to severe eschatological consequences. The three figures—the elderly adulterer, the cuckold who permits it, and the promiscuous woman—represent distinct failures in maintaining sexual and marital integrity, with the 'Daiuth' specifically highlighting the loss of masculine honor through passive tolerance. This triad underscores the Shia scholarly view that 'Ghayra' is not merely emotion but a critical component of faith and social order.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘There are three to whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will not be Speaking to on the Day of Judgement, nor will He<sup>azwj</sup> be Purifying them, and for them is a painful Punishment – the elderly adulterer, and the cuckold (pimp), and a woman who allows men to go in the bed of her busband with her’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

On the Day of Judgment Allah will not speak to three kinds of people and will not cleanse them and they suffer a painful suffering. One is an old fornicating man, a pimp and a woman who allows men to go in the bed of her husband with her.’”
